name: neuralos
description: neuralOS instances as RTerm agent tools — on-device data agents over verified probe menus (chinook, cyberbank, aws, efraud, ...). The 121M neuralOS engine selects the probe for a plain-English question and the instance's Python bridge executes it against the real data source; the engine ships with the desktop bundle and the standalone backend auto-provisions ~/.cache/neuralos on first use. Four tools: neuralos_list_instances, neuralos_ask, neuralos_graph (relationship maps), neuralos_admin (write probes behind a confirm="yes" interlock). Config in Settings (neuralos block: instancesDir, pythonBin, engineBin/engineWeights, autoDownload); instances root defaults to ~/neuralos-instances.
